basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Jodhpur Field Investigator Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 35 years (till the last date of the advertisement)

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree in Life Science (MSc-Biochemistry/Pharmacology/Microbiology)/Public Health (MPH) OR Graduate in Medical Science (MBBS/BDS/BAMS/BHMS)

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Field Investigator Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.all_india_institute_of_medical_sciences_: Tribal districts of Rajasthan: Banswara, Dungarpur, Pratapgarh, Udaipur, Rajsamand, Chittorgarh, Sirohi and Pali, AIIMS Jodhpur
Master's degree in Life Science (MSc-Biochemistry/Pharmacology/Microbiology)/Public Health (MPH) OR Graduate in Medical Science (MBBS/BDS/BAMS/BHMS)
Maximum 35 years (till the last date of the advertisement)

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Field Investigator Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The venue is given in the official notification (see the link below).

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. AIIMS/JDH/PHARMA/01 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download AIIMS Jodhpur notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Should be ready to travel and stay in the remote and rural tribal areas Should be able to form good rapport with all stakeholders All qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and full-time Experience should be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualification Desirable: Research/field work experience in public health projects in a government/autonomous/PSU/recognized organization Knowledge of computer applications

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification No additional candidates entertained after 3:00 PM on the interview day

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Consolidated sum without any other benefits, based on experience, qualifications, skill set, etc. of the candidates. Tenure 04 Months Purely temporary/contractual basis, co-terminus with the project No right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur or continuation in any other project

content_sections.heading: How Will AIIMS Jodhpur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in Interview Walk-in interview at AIIMS Jodhpur on 25-11-2026

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled application in the prescribed format with passport size photo Biodata All relevant original documents One set of self-attested photocopies regarding age, qualifications and relevant experience All essential qualification and experience certificates enclosed with the application form No Objection Certificate for persons working in Govt. or Public Sector undertaking

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format given on page 3 of the notice. Bring the filled application and Biodata on the day of the Walk-In-Interview. Appear in person with all relevant original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies regarding age, qualifications and relevant experience. Enclose all essential qualification and experience certificates with the application form. Report between 2:00 PM and 3:00 PM on 25-11-2026 at Room no. 234, 2nd Floor, Medical college building, AIIMS Jodhpur.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA admissible to appear in the interview Number of posts may increase/decrease at the sole discretion of Research Section, AIIMS Jodhpur No enquiries entertained after due date Application without essential qualification and experience certificates will be considered incomplete

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026, and candidates report at 2:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Field Investigator.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 25 November 2026 at 2:00 PM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (till the last date of the advertisement). Relaxation: Service in other research projects Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on case-to-case basis.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 35,000 monthly (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree in Life Science (MSc-Biochemistry/Pharmacology/Microbiology)/Public Health (MPH) OR Graduate in Medical Science (MBBS/BDS/BAMS/BHMS).

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Should be ready to travel and stay in the remote and rural tribal areas. Should be able to form good rapport with all stakeholders. All qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and full-time. Experience should be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualification.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. No additional candidates entertained after 3:00 PM on the interview day.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview. Walk-in interview at AIIMS Jodhpur on 25-11-2026.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tenure 04 Months. Purely temporary/contractual basis, co-terminus with the project. No right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur or continuation in any other project.
